fix.shows: From the lists of names left off Karnataka's draft roll of 24 August 2026 for all 224 constituencies, the Sabar Institute counts 1,08,24,651 names with a recorded reason, which it puts at 20.4% of the 2023 roll. It finds 15.1% marked dead, and it describes the other 91,85,436, marked shifted, untraceable or absent, already enrolled elsewhere or as having refused the form, as alive. It reports that Bengaluru Urban has 18% of the state's electors and 44% of the names, and that in Bommanahalli, C.V. Raman Nagar, Dasarahalli, B.T.M. Layout and Vijay Nagar more names were left off than votes were cast in 2023. It finds 2,102 of the 4,926 third gender electors on the 2023 roll, 42.7%, on the lists. Among electors aged 18 to 29 marked a reason other than death it counts about three women for every two men, and nearly two for one outside Bengaluru. Outside Bengaluru Urban, by its correlations, districts with more Scheduled Caste residents and districts with lower income per head had more names left off.
